title: Move app utilities into a side drawer
summary: The avatar now opens a right-side App & Account drawer, removing persistent settings clutter from the top while keeping Night context prominent.
changes: Persistent gear and install controls have been removed from the visible top bars; the avatar is now the single entry point for account and app utilities.
Account now opens as a right-edge drawer with direct destinations for Personalise, Notifications, Appearance, App & Help, Security and administrator-only Roster management.
Night uses the freed space to reduce top chrome and remove the redundant staffing chip while preserving the shared shift identity as the visual anchor.
Notifications opens the existing Chat alert controls directly, while Roster management continues to use the existing administrator area and permissions.
